title: Rex and the Runaway Ball
skill: CVC words with short e (Rex, red, get, wet) and blends (ball, roll, dark)
skill_description: Practice reading CVC words with short e while learning about courage and friendship
author: FunBookies

story_bible.premise: Rex is a small golden puppy who loves his red ball more than anything. One sunny day while playing with his friend Rosie the rabbit, the ball bounces away and rolls into a dark tunnel under the old stone bridge. Rex is scared of the dark, but with Rosie's encouragement, he finds the courage to go in alone and retrieve his beloved ball.
themes: courage in the face of fear

character_arcs.Rex: Happy playing → Worried when ball rolls away → Scared of dark tunnel → Encouraged by friend → Bravely enters alone → Proud and happy
character_arcs.Rosie: Playful friend → Supportive when Rex is scared → Cheers Rex on → Celebrates his success

story_bible.setting: A sunny meadow with an old stone bridge over a small stream. Under the bridge is a dark tunnel where the water flows through. The meadow has green grass, wildflowers, and a few trees. Weather is sunny and warm throughout.
story_bible.plot_summary:
Rex the puppy and Rosie the rabbit are playing in a sunny meadow. Rex loves bouncing his red ball. But one big bounce sends the ball rolling away - right into the dark tunnel under the old stone bridge!

Rex runs to the tunnel entrance and looks in. It's so dark! He can see his red ball sitting in there, but he's too scared to go in. 'It's too dark!' Rex whimpers.

Rosie hops over. 'You can do it, Rex! You're brave!' she says. Rex looks at the tunnel, then at Rosie, then back at the tunnel. He takes a deep breath.

Slowly, step by step, Rex walks into the dark tunnel. It's cold and dark, but he keeps going. He can see his red ball! He grabs it in his mouth and turns around.

Rex runs back out into the sunshine, ball in mouth, tail wagging proudly. 'I did it!' he barks. Rosie cheers. They play together, and Rex feels brave.

emotional_beats.beat: Joy - Rex and Rosie playing happily in sunshine
Fun - Rex bouncing his beloved red ball
Surprise/worry - Ball bounces away toward tunnel
Fear - Rex at tunnel entrance, scared of the dark
Determination - Rex deciding to be brave
Tension - Rex alone in dark tunnel

comprehension_questions.question: What did Rex love to play with?
Did Rex get his ball back?
comprehension_questions.answer: Yes, he was brave and got it!

parent_tips.before_reading: Look at the cover. What animal do you see? What is he chasing? Have you ever been scared of something dark? This story is about being brave even when you're scared.
parent_tips.during_reading: Help sound out: Rex, red, ball, run, sun. Notice how Rex feels at different points - happy, scared, brave, proud. Use different voices!
parent_tips.after_reading: Talk about times your child felt scared but did something brave anyway. Discuss how friends can help us feel braver.
